## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated when behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] No secrets, local paths, logs, or personal data added

## Notes

Call out intentional tool-contract changes, compatibility changes, or follow-up work.
